summary: Blue Owl Digital Infrastructure Trust filed an 8-K covering routine unregistered sales of equity under Section 4(a)(2)/Reg D/S and monthly distribution declarations. On August 3, 2026, it sold 1,566,499 common shares across four classes for gross proceeds of ~$16.5 million, based on July 31, 2026 NAV. NAV per share ranged from $10.4671 (Class S) to $10.6741 (Class E). Monthly distributions of $0.0416667 per share were declared on July 27, 2026, payable August 18, 2026. No merger, acquisition, tender, or special-situation event is present.
